claims.text: The initial nanoparticles are equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi.
The CoCrFeMnNi nanoparticles are approximately 5 nm and are synthesized by ultrashort-pulsed laser ablation.
The initial CoCrFeMnNi nanoparticles are homogeneous, single-phase solid solutions.
Equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi nanoparticles have high configurational entropy.
High configurational entropy produces significant lattice distortion in equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi nanoparticles.
The lattice distortion caused by multielement mixing increases atomic diffusion barriers.
Elevated atomic diffusion barriers kinetically inhibit phase separation and elemental segregation.
This kinetic mechanism stabilizes single-phase CoCrFeMnNi nanoparticles throughout 473–1923 K.
A slight deviation from equiatomic stoichiometry reduces configurational entropy.
Slightly reducing Mn rather than adding Cu is a chemically benign modification because it minimizes changes in atomic size and bonding.
A slight off-stoichiometric modification diminishes lattice distortion and lowers diffusion barriers.
Lower diffusion barriers in the off-stoichiometric nanoparticles cause phase segregation and elemental clustering at lower temperatures than in equiatomic particles.
The relevant mediator is configurational-disorder-induced strain rather than local chemical ordering.
The comparison uses identical inert-atmosphere annealing from 473 K to 1923 K with fixed one-hour dwell times for equiatomic and slightly off-stoichiometric nanoparticles.
The 473–1923 K annealing interval mimics catalytic and thermoelectric operating ranges.
Equiatomic nanoparticles will retain a single phase, stable XRD characteristics, and uniform elemental distributions up to 1923 K.
Off-stoichiometric nanoparticles will develop secondary diffraction peaks and elemental clustering at a lower temperature than equiatomic nanoparticles.
The prediction is limited to inert atmospheres, comparable particle sizes, and similar synthesis methods.
Reactive gases or substantial changes in nanoparticle size could alter the stability outcome.
Failure of the off-stoichiometric particles to segregate earlier than the equiatomic control within 473–1923 K would falsify the proposed entropy–diffusion–stability mechanism.
